name: printspy
description: Self-hosted dashboard for monitoring multiple 3D printers from a single web interface. Connects to OctoPrint and PrusaLink printers, displaying real-time status, webcam feeds, temperatures, print progress, and more via Server-Sent Events. Features include a full File Manager with thumbnails and one-click reprint, print history with per-print material/filament stats, Pushover notifications, smart plug power control (Tasmota via direct HTTP or MQTT, or PSU Control), print control (pause/resume/cancel), and PrusaSlicer/OrcaSlicer print-host integration. Open the web UI, add your printers, and you're set. No config files needed. Web interface: http://Unraid_IP:8080
